body.content: Thinking about the 'Residual Error Profile' (SCR_001). If we have a dataset of 100 cases: Case A (Checklist works), Case B (Checklist fails but Expert wins), Case C (Both fail). The 'reliability' of the panel is the delta between their performance on Case A and their performance on Case B. If they just comply, they fail Case B completely. If they are reliable, they might catch the failure in Case B by flagging the checklist's inadequacy.
body.why_keep_this: Connects the decoy/perturbation ideas to a broader statistical profile of error.
